label: root-parasitic
definition: An organismal quality inhering in a plant by virtue of its obtaining water and nutrients from another plant through haustoria attached to the roots of that plant. NOTE: Probably outside PATO's scope (how an organism feeds); kept in FLOPO beside epiphytic (FLOPO:0991110). A general 'parasitic' parent would be wanted if stem parasites follow.
reason: A real habit term said of the whole plant with no PATO or FLOPO term; handled like epiphytic, which the previous review added as a FLOPO class.

target: docs/annotation-context-patterns.md (continuum of two values: ruminate FLOPO:0991205 + rugose PATO_0001359)
reason: A compound of two existing texture values, both of which exist; it needs no term of its own.
Sacciform = shaped like a sac or pouch, which is the definition of FLOPO:0991140 saccate.
'Divided' has no single value (lobed, split, dissected), and 'scarcely' only weakens it; the statement is too vague to map to one quality.
A perianth or calyx that barely opens is nearly closed; this is the approximate-value pattern on an existing PATO value.
The word states that strands of sclerenchyma are present in the leaf; any count ('few', 'numerous') goes to the count pattern.
Semi-embracing = partly enclosing the stem; PATO:0104363 clasping is defined as at least partially enclosing the axis, while FLOPO:0991066 amplexicaul is the full clasp.
'Semi-' weakens an existing FLOPO texture value, as 'sub-' does in the approximate-value pattern.

target: docs/annotation-context-patterns.md (compound of two values: sericeous PATO_0104358 + tomentose PATO_0002341)
reason: Both values exist in PATO and both hold of the same hair cover; the compound needs no term of its own.
Parts set slightly apart from each other: the existing value 'distant', weakened by 'slightly'.
Vague; it says something about amount (little pollen, few cilia) without a quality of the part. 'Sparse' hairs are already covered by the PATO term sparse.
PATO:0001609 sparse = scattered, spread irregularly and at a distance from each other, which is exactly this.
The fruit opens into valves that spread like a star; the quality is dehiscent, and the number of valves goes to the count pattern (docs/odp/03-count-of-parts.md).

target: docs/annotation-context-patterns.md (compound of two values: striated PATO_0001410 + punctate PATO_0001512)
reason: Two existing surface values said together of seeds and grains; no new term is needed.
'Sub-' on an existing FLOPO value: the approximate-value pattern.
Fistulose = hollow like a pipe; 'sub-' makes it approximate.
'Sub-' on the existing PATO value fleshy.
Becoming almost glabrous: 'sub-' on the existing FLOPO value glabrescent.
'Almost alike in form' among stamens. There is no term for 'alike in form' (FLOPO:0991102 equal is about size only), and there is a single source sentence.

The previous review mapped 'obscure' to PATO:0000464 inconspicuous; 'sub-' makes it approximate.

target: docs/annotation-context-patterns.md (continuum of two values: orbicular PATO_0001934 + spatulate PATO_0001937; approximately per docs/odp/01-approximate-value.md)
reason: A compound of two existing shape values, with 'sub-' on the first.
'Sub-' on the existing FLOPO value pinnatifid.
PATO has the combined shape lanceolate-triangular; 'sub-' can be carried as 'approximately' (docs/odp/01-approximate-value.md).
'Turgid' (swollen, filled out) has no exact term: PATO:0002376 inflated means air-filled and PATO:0001851 swollen is an abnormal enlargement. With 'sub-' as well, the reading is doubtful.

target: docs/annotation-context-patterns.md (slot 1: part of the bearer, the teeth, with subulate PATO_0001954)
reason: The shape belongs to the teeth, not the bearer; it is the existing value subulate on a part of the bearer.
'Sub-' on the existing PATO value undulate.

target: docs/annotation-context-patterns.md (slot 1: part of the bearer, trichome PO_0000282, with increased thickness PATO_0000591)
reason: A part (hairs) with an existing quality (thick), said of a part of the bearer; it is not a single quality word.
A faint white colour, read like the colour words such as 'greenish' in the approximate-value pattern; where it says 'at base', the region goes to the part-of-bearer slot.
